purpose: Teach: こもり/思いがけない/片づけ/寝かせ/横顔/思い当たる/ホタル/育た

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、部屋にこもりすぎだろ
lines.en: Riku, you're basically living in that room. Come on.
lines.style: Dry, affectionate tease. Quick attack on his name. Slight roll of the eyes audible in the tone. Not mean — familiar.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、思いがけない情報くれたな、桜
lines.en: Hey, Sakura — you actually surprised me with that one.
lines.style: Genuine appreciation breaking through cool-guy exterior. Softer on her name at the end. Small, real smile in the voice. Not performed.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、教室の片づけ、お前手伝えよ
lines.en: Come on, help me clean up the classroom. I mean it.
lines.style: Direct but not harsh. The tone shifts slightly firm on the second sentence — she's calling in a favor and wants him to know she needs it. Not negotiating.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、妹を寝かせて来たのか?桜
lines.en: Did you actually get your sister to sleep before dragging me out here?
lines.style: Warm curiosity with a hint of affectionate worry underneath. Genuine question, not teasing. Leans on her name gently at the end.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の横顔、漫画みたいだぜ
lines.en: Your profile is ridiculous. You look like you walked out of a manga.
lines.style: Playful, caught-red-handed. Rush the first part slightly — she's admitting something she didn't mean to say. Soft landing on the final phrase, a little self-conscious.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テストの問題、思い当たるか?桜
lines.en: Do you remember what that test question was about?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly searching. Not urgent — genuine attempt to recall together. Her name comes as an afterthought, like he's checking in. Quieter at the end.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、夜の公園にホタルがいるんだぜ
lines.en: There are fireflies out at the park at night. Come see them with me.
lines.style: Bright, inviting. Opens with energy and genuine excitement. The second sentence dips slightly — softer, more vulnerable beneath the eagerness. Real invitation.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 日陰じゃ育たない植物もあるって聞いたぜ、桜。お前のお庭で育てたトマト、ちゃんと育ったろ?桜
lines.en: You know, some plants don't grow in the shade. Like those tomatoes you grew in your garden — they turned out great, didn't they?
lines.style: Calm, reflective. Winds through the thought without rushing. Genuine warmth on the memory of her accomplishment. Lands softly on her name. The kind of thing said while looking at something else, not at her.
